name: Client project
description: Kickoff to invoice for one client: assets, drafts, their review, delivery and a testimonial.

tasks.name: Kickoff call
tasks.description: Agree on the goal, the scope, the deadline and who signs off. Put the notes in this task so everyone works from the same page.

tasks.name: Collect brand assets and access
tasks.description: Ask for everything in one message, so the client answers once.

tasks.name: Share the timeline with the client
tasks.description: The dates they'll see work, and the dates we need their answers by. Share the project with them (Share with a client) so they can follow along.

tasks.name: First draft
tasks.description: Good enough to react to, not polished. Note any open questions at the top.

tasks.name: Send the draft for review
tasks.description: Move the task to Client review. Ask for all feedback in one round, by a date.

tasks.name: Revisions
tasks.description: Work through the feedback. Anything outside the agreed scope gets its own task and its own price.

tasks.name: Final delivery
tasks.description: Hand over the files and the logins, with a short note on how to use what we made.

tasks.name: Send the invoice
tasks.description: If the team logged time on this project, OneCamp makes the invoice from it: open the project's time (the clock) and choose Make an invoice.

tasks.name: Ask for a testimonial
tasks.description: A week after delivery, when the work has proven itself. Two or three sentences in their words is plenty.

name: Product launch
description: Two weeks to launch day: positioning, the page, the post, the emails and a retro.

tasks.name: Write the positioning brief
tasks.description: Who it's for, the problem it solves, why now, and the one sentence everyone will repeat.

tasks.name: Draft the launch page
tasks.description: Lead with the problem and the one sentence from the brief. One clear call to action.

tasks.name: Check pricing and plans
tasks.description: The numbers on the page, the checkout and the docs all say the same thing.

tasks.name: Record a short demo
tasks.description: Two minutes or less, one take is fine. Show the problem, then the product solving it.

tasks.name: Write the announcement post
tasks.description: What's new, who it helps and how to try it. Link the demo.

tasks.name: Email existing customers
tasks.description: Short and personal: what changed for them and the one thing to try first.

tasks.name: Launch day
tasks.description: Keep this task open all day and tick the steps off as they go out.

subtasks.name: Publish the page and the post
Share it where our people are
Answer every question within the hour

tasks.name: Launch retro
tasks.description: Thirty minutes: the numbers, what worked, and what we'd do differently next time.

name: Website redesign
description: From an audit of the old site to launch, with redirects so links and search rankings carry over.

tasks.name: Audit the current site
tasks.description: Which pages people visit, what's out of date and what's broken. Export the analytics before anything changes.

tasks.name: Sitemap and content plan
tasks.description: Every page the new site will have, what it's for, and who writes it.

tasks.name: Wireframes
tasks.description: Layout only, in grey. Agree on these before anything gets colour.

tasks.name: Visual design
tasks.description: The home page and one inner page first; the rest follow their lead.

tasks.name: Write and collect the copy
tasks.description: Real words, not placeholder text, before the build starts.

tasks.name: Set up redirects
tasks.description: Map every old address to its new one, so old links and search rankings carry over.

tasks.name: Check analytics and search a week on
tasks.description: Look for pages that lost visits and addresses that now lead nowhere.

name: Feature build
description: One feature from spec to release: design, build, code review, QA and the release note.

tasks.name: Write the spec
tasks.description: The problem, who has it, what done looks like, and what's out of scope.

tasks.name: Design
tasks.description: The flows and the screens, the empty and error states included.

tasks.name: Tests
tasks.description: The cases from the spec, and the bug you'd be embarrassed to ship.

tasks.name: QA pass
tasks.description: Move tasks to QA as they're ready. Test it as the person in the spec would use it.

tasks.name: Write the release note
tasks.description: What changed and who it helps, in a sentence or two.

name: Event
description: Six weeks to a meetup, an offsite or a conference day, and the follow-up after it.

tasks.name: Set the date, the budget and the goal
Book the venue
tasks.description: Check the capacity, the access, the Wi-Fi and what's included before signing.

tasks.name: Plan the agenda and invite speakers
Order food and drinks
tasks.description: Ask about dietary needs in the registration form.

tasks.name: Badges, signs and the run sheet

subtasks.name: Run sheet: who does what, minute by minute

tasks.name: Remind the attendees
tasks.description: Where, when, how to get there and who to call on the day.

name: New hire onboarding
description: From a week before their first day to the 90-day review: accounts, a buddy and check-ins.

tasks.name: Send the welcome email
tasks.description: The start date and time, where to go, who to ask for, and what to bring.

subtasks.name: Invite to OneCamp and their team's channels

tasks.name: Pick a buddy
tasks.description: Someone outside their reporting line to ask the questions they won't ask their manager.

tasks.name: First day: welcome, tour and lunch
Walk through how we work
tasks.description: The handbook, the policies, and where things live in OneCamp.

tasks.name: Their first small task, shipped
tasks.description: Something real and small, done in their first week.

name: Security audit prep
description: The groundwork before an auditor or a customer's security review: policies, access, backups and evidence.

tasks.name: Agree on the scope and the auditor
tasks.description: Which standard or questionnaire, which systems are in scope, and the dates.

tasks.name: Gather the policies
tasks.description: Keep each policy as a doc, with its owner and the date it was last reviewed.

tasks.name: Review who has access to what
tasks.description: Remove the accounts of people who left, and admin rights nobody uses.

tasks.name: Review vendors
tasks.description: Every service that holds our data or our customers' data, and what it holds.

tasks.name: Test a restore from backup
tasks.description: Restore to a spare server, check the data is all there, and note how long it took.

tasks.name: Collect the evidence
tasks.description: Screenshots, exports and logs, one folder per control, named so the auditor can find them.

tasks.name: Fix what they found
tasks.description: One task per finding, each with an owner and a date.
